Isolated older adults find joy and connection through virtual singing
Those with neurocognitive disorders like dementia especially benefit
April 22, 2025
| By
Kristin Samuelson
Members of the Good Memories Choir, which includes patients with early-stage memory loss and their care partners singing together. The Northwestern Medicine study finds virtual group singing can be an effective tool for promoting well-being and social connection during isolation — including for those with dementia.
Aging
Brain
Feinberg School of Medicine
Mental Health
Music
American philosopher and psychologist William James once said, “I don’t sing because I’m happy. I’m happy because I sing.”
A new Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine study finds that, even when singing with others in a virtual setting, the benefits abound.
In collaboration with Illinois-based
Sounds Good Choir,
the study assessed the feasibility of virtual group singing for adults over 55 — including those with neurocognitive disorders like dementia — during the COVID-19 pandemic when older adults were experiencing health declines due to isolation. It found virtual group singing can be an effective tool for promoting well-being and social connection during isolation.
“Beyond the pandemic, the study suggests virtual singing could benefit individuals in rural areas, those with mobility limitations or those experiencing social anxiety,” said principal investigator
Dr. Borna Bonakdarpour
, director of the Northwestern Music and Medicine Program, associate professor of neurology at Feinberg and a physician with the
Mesulam Center for Cognitive Neurology and Alzheimer’s Disease
. “We found virtual group singing could provide emotional, cognitive and social support through accessible, engaging music programs for diverse aging populations.”
For people with neurocognitive disorders music and singing can offer alternative ways of expression.
Singing engages diverse neurophysiological processes by activating a neural network involved in respiratory control, emotional regulation and motor control, Bonakdarpour said. Lung capacity, posture and overall physical health often improve through the practice of singing. And choral singing has been increasingly recognized as a therapeutic activity for both cognitively healthy older adults and individuals with dementia and neurocognitive disorders.
For people with neurocognitive disorders — who frequently struggle with verbal communication — music and singing can offer alternative ways to express themselves, much like we see in individuals with aphasia,” Bonakdarpour said. “Singing familiar songs can help facilitate communication and create a comfortable, low-pressure environment for interaction and sharing.”
Lower anxiety, and higher levels of connection
Previous research has focused on one group of singers and had fewer participants compared to this study, which compared two different group-singing interventions: a sing-along series with 52 weekly sessions of familiar music and a structured choir with rehearsals leading to a virtual concert. Of the 176 individuals surveyed, responses revealed high satisfaction, particularly in areas like anxiety reduction, social connection and physical well-being. The sing-alongs helped evoke emotional resonance through positive memories, while choir participation promoted intellectual engagement.
A Good Memories performance by members of the Sounds Good Choir in Buchanan Chapel at Fourth Presbyterian Church in Chicago. The choir is the Chicago area’s largest no-audition choral program for adults over 55.
The overall tone of the responses was overwhelmingly positive, with 86.9% of responses mentioning positive impacts on well-being as a result of participation. In at least 5% of free responses, respondents mentioned the following themes: emotional well-being (36%); social well-being (31%); intellectual well-being (18%); sense of normalcy or structure (12%); spiritual well-being (11%); physical well-being (7%); and connection to the past (5%).
“Participants in the group choir during the pandemic consistently described the activity as providing a sense of normalcy amid widespread disruption — a theme that emerged prominently and merits further investigation,” Bonakdarpour said. “For individuals living with dementia, irrespective of external circumstances, the erosion of normalcy profoundly impacts their sense of self and contributes to anxiety. This suggests that such interventions may help restore a feeling of normalcy, supporting psychological well-being and offering a means of reconnecting with a stable sense of self.”
Listen to a virtual concert from spring 2020
>
The next step in the research will be a nationwide trial funded by the National Institutes of Health Music Dementia Research Network.

By:
Erin Blakemore
Inventions & Science
Inside the Rise and Fall of Toys ‘R’ Us
The retailer turned everyone into a “Toys ‘R’ Us kid”… by driving its competition out of existence.
Erin Blakemore
Published:
March 19, 2018
Last Updated:
January 29, 2025
Print
Copy
It was 1948, and Charles Lazarus had a hunch. Newly returned from World War II, he knew he wanted to go into business, and he knew—long before the term “baby boom” was a common phrase—that his friends were about to start having lots of babies.
“Everyone I talked to said they were going to go home, get married, have children and live the American dream,” he told
Entrepreneur
in 2008. “I decided that I would open a store in my father’s bicycle-repair shop. But instead of selling bikes, I would sell cribs, carriages, strollers, high chairs—everything for the baby. My instincts told me the timing was right.”
Chronicling the untold stories that gave rise to the modern toy industry.
Stream Now
View Details
Those instincts didn’t just help Lazarus capitalize on the baby boom: They helped originate Toys ‘R’ Us. Once a retail juggernaut, the store dominated the entire toy industry—and children’s imaginations—by driving its competitors out of existence.
Now, the retail giant has been forced into bankruptcy, the victim of a retail model it helped pioneer. In March 2017, the 70-year-old business
announced
that it would call it quits. It was the end of an era for the store that once held a lock on the entire toy industry and made toy shopping—once a seasonal treat—into a regular family outing.
Lazarus opened his first store, Children’s Bargain Town, in Washington, D.C. in 1948. Specializing in baby goods, it only began selling toys once Lazarus realized customers didn’t come back for more strollers, high chairs and other baby goods with their second child. He started selling a few inexpensive toys, then added to his inventory as they proved popular.
But Lazarus wasn’t content to stop with a single store. He had an idea that was bigger than Children’s Bargain Town or any kids’ store he had ever seen—a massive store filled with every toy in existence. In 1957, he got out of the baby furniture business, renamed his company Toys ‘R’ Us and created the first ever big-box toy store.
The new megastore took a supermarket-style approach to toy selling, which distinguished it from every other toy store in existence. Most toy stores were small and family-run, and only carried a limited line of products. Lazarus’ stores, on the other hand, were orders of magnitude larger than their competitors, and presented a smorgasbord of thousands of different toys.
Big-box stores like Toys ‘R’ Us astonished the era’s consumers, who had simply never seen stores that big and crammed with merchandise. “What Lazarus really captured was this sense of American abundance after the war and after all those years of depression,” says
Richard Gottlieb
, founder of Global Toy Experts and an authority on the toy business.
Gottlieb sees Lazarus as part of a bigger wave of entrepreneurship that took hold in the post-war years. “The modern American toy industry was really created by Jewish soldiers coming back from the war,” he says. Other Jewish industry superstars include
Isaac Heller
, who converted military surplus into toys for boys in the 1950s,
Elliot Handler
, the founder of Mattel, and
Milton Levine
, creator of the wildly popular “Milton’s Ant Farm,” which was a hit with kids during the 1950s and 1960s.
1970s Toys R Us ad, still associated with the Children’s Bargain Town name.
Rusty Blazenhoff/Flickr Creative Commons/CC BY-NC 2.0
1970s Toys R Us ad, still associated with the Children’s Bargain Town name.
Rusty Blazenhoff/Flickr Creative Commons/CC BY-NC 2.0
Lazarus’ idea was deceptively simple: build a supermarket for toys. While other toy shops had display cases and decorative interiors, Toys ‘R’ Us had concrete or tile flooring (better for the bottom line) and rows of toys laid out next to each other, grocery store-style. The store’s bare-bones appearance didn’t seem to matter to consumers, who were entranced by the toys within.

data.title: Projects for Old OS X
data.author: pierremenard
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者在2019年决定放弃现代macOS，转而修复和使用旧版Mac系统软件的经历。作者修改了一些因API停用而失效的小工具，如天气、单位转换和翻译部件，并提供了下载和使用说明。此外，还提供了旧版网络浏览、音视频处理、系统调整、游戏模拟器等多种工具和补丁，以帮助用户在老系统上实现新功能或修复问题。这些修改版软件旨在帮助苹果用户在旧操作系统上继续使用他们熟悉的功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：macOS系统的发展与用户体验

不同观点：
• Reason077认为苹果应将Dashboard功能带回现代macOS版本，并提出具体的改进建议，如将Dashboard作为一个特殊桌面，通过单个F键或手势访问，并允许自由组织小部件布局。
• ksec对Swift语言的发展持保留态度，认为苹果应继续使用Objective-C并优化旧代码库，同时指出macOS功能逐渐增多但实用性未显著提升，并期待在停止支持x86 Mac时进行大清理。
• hyperjeff提供了一个旧Mac软件和开源项目的归档链接，供寻找旧Mac软件的用户参考，并提到该列表在App Store上线后停止更新。
• caseyy认为自"big cat"时代以来，macOS增加了许多功能但实用工具和功能性仅增加了约10%，并对此表示反思。
• behnamoh对比了macOS和Windows的键盘快捷键体验，指出macOS在某些方面优于Windows，但在安装*.pkg文件和使用菜单快捷键等方面不如Windows便捷。
• zombot赞赏Sonoma系统中的一些新功能，如多语言文本发音，但同时对无法在最新Intel iMac上安装10.14以及在Apple Silicon上无法运行某些游戏表示不满。
• dang提供了一个与旧版本OS X项目相关的讨论链接，供进一步参考。
• mattl对某页面效果在旧Mac上的表现持负面评价，并怀疑其在旧Mac上的表现不佳。
• brian-armstrong对仍将旧OSX连接到互联网表示担忧，指出可能存在许多无法修补的关键漏洞。

补充讨论：
• 用户对macOS系统功能增减的看法不一，有的希望恢复旧功能（如Dashboard），有的则期待系统清理和大规模更新。
• 对旧Mac软件和系统的支持问题引发讨论，部分用户关注旧版本的可用性和安全性。
• 键盘快捷键的使用体验成为对比macOS和Windows的一个具体争议点，用户对两者的优缺点进行了详细比较。
• 对新系统功能（如Sonoma）的评价存在分歧，有的用户赞赏新功能，有的用户则对硬件和软件兼容性问题表示不满。

43767944.article_content:
I
n the fall of 2019, I came to a decision: it was time to leave modern macOS behind.
A decade prior, switching to OS X had been a revelatory experience, as though the software was working in perfect sync with my mind. That feeling had long since disappeared.
I surveyed the computing landscape. Windows was still fine, and Linux was still Linux. A normal person would have just picked one, but I was apparently not a normal person. I cared far too much about having the
perfect
computer, and I couldn't get that wonderful memory out of my head...
Fixed Dashboard Widgets
Weather
OS X 10.4 – 10.14
Apple's weather widget broke in 2019, when the APIs it used went offline. This version has been modified to use the HERE API instead.
Users are highly encouraged to add a personal API key to ensure continued functionality. Please see the included Readme for details.
Download
Unit Converter
OS X 10.8 – 10.14
Apple's unit converter widget stopped recieving exchange rate updates in 2020, when Yahoo Finance was shut down. This version has been modified to use the Exchangerate.host API instead.
Download
Translation
OS X 10.6 – 10.14
Apple's translation widget broke in 2019, when the API it used went offline. This version has been modified to use the Deepl.com API instead. A free Deepl account is required.
Some assembly required. Please see the included Readme for details.
Download
Weather, Unit Converter, and Translation widgets are the property of Apple. Modified versions are redistributed in good faith to help Apple customers.
Web Browsing & Internet
Chromium Legacy Downloader
OS X 10.7 – 10.10
Easily update the Chromium web browser on old OS X.
Relies on the Chromium Legacy project maintained by Bluebox.
Download
Legacy Mac Proxy
OS X 10.6 – 10.13
A proxy server designed to fix HTTPS problems.
Download
Transmission
OS X 10.9
A Mavericks-compatible build of the Transmission torrent client.
Based on Transmission 3.0.0. Includes fixes backported from Transmission 4.0 by Krackers.
Download
Apple Mail Security Fix
OS X 10.6 – 10.12
A mail plugin which fixes CVE-2020-9922, a scary zero-click vulnerability.
Download
Audio & Video
QuickTime 10.2 for Mavericks
OS X 10.9
Mavericks ships with QuickTime Player 10.3, which is incompatible with third-party codecs. Replace it with this modified vesion of QuickTime 10.2 from Mountain Lion.
QuickTime Player is the property of Apple. This modified version is redistributed in good faith to help Apple customers.
Download
FFusion 2021
QuickTime 7.0 – 10.2
A component for QuickTime 10.2 and below which adds compatibilty with a variety of non-Apple video codecs including HEVC and VP9. Requires a powerful CPU!
Based on RJVB's version of FFusion, which was based on the Perian Project's version of FFusion, which was based on the original by Jérôme Cornen. Also incorporates code by MaddTheSane.
Download
QuickTime Helper
OS X 10.9
A tiny app to open video containers that QuickTime X can't open by itself, including MKV and WebM.
App icon by Princess Cake.
Download
Preview Helper
OS X 10.9
A tiny app to open images that Preview can't open by itself, including HEIC, WebP, and BPG.
Includes and relies on QuickLook generators by maxpozdeev, dethi, and emin.
Download
Video Downloader Service
OS X 10.9 – 10.14
An Automator Service for downloading videos from Youtube and other video streaming sites. Just open a web page with a video in Chromium Legacy, and activate the Service by selecting Chromium → Services → Download Video in the menu bar, or assign the Service to a keyboard shortcut in System Preferences.
Download
Media Subscriptions Preference Pane
OS X 10.9 – 10.14
Your favorite podcast episodes and Youtube videos, automatically delivered to your Mac's
Music
and
Movies
folders. No app required, just add feeds and channels in System Preferences.
Download
Downloaded videos will be playable in Quicktime 10.2 with FFusion 2021 installed.
Games & Emulators
OpenEmu Lite
OS X 10.7+
A Mac-native emulator for NES, SNES, Genesis, NDS, and all flavors of Gameboy games. Based on OpenEmu, but with a stripped-down interface and no library functionality, so you can open a game in Finder and start playing right away.
Download
Dolphin for Legacy OS X
OS X 10.9 – 10.13
A custom build of the Dolphin Wii and Gamecube emulator.
Based on Dolphin v5.18628
from February 12, 2023
Download
Steam API Emulator
OS X 10.6+
Patch Steam games to make them playable again on operating systems which Steam no longer supports.
Download
System Tweaks
SIMBL for Mavericks
OS X 10.9
A Mavericks-compatible version of SIMBL, a plugin system for Mac apps. A few of my favorite plugins are included.
Download
Snow Leopard Window Controls for Mavericks
OS X 10.9
Replace Mavericks's small "traffic light" window buttons with the larger ones from Snow Leopard.
Download
Emoji Update for Mavericks
OS X 10.8 – 10.9
Adds newer emojis to the Mavericks emoji picker.
Download
Miscellaneous Apps
Wowfunhappy's SyncThing
OS X 10.9+
SyncThing keeps files in sync

data.title: The Illuminated Gospel of St John
data.author: ycombinete
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于纽约公共图书馆内的“珍宝”展览及各类 illuminated manuscript（ illuminated 手稿）的相关讨论

不同观点：
• [credit_guy] 介绍纽约公共图书馆的“珍宝”展览，特别提到一件14世纪的 illuminated manuscript，并附上图片链接。
• [jfengel] 赞赏《约翰福音》的诗意，并提到 King James 版本的翻译虽不准确但有力，同时表达对 illuminated manuscript 中隐藏的典故和注释的兴趣，认为中世纪的手稿充满复杂的隐喻。
• [harepods] 感叹现代人手写能力的退化，看到这样的精密艺术作品感到欣慰。
• [brudgers] 联想到 Robert Crumb 的《创世纪》漫画，可能与 illuminated manuscript 的艺术表现形式有异曲同工之处。
• [iterateoften] 误以为讨论的是 St. John’s Illuminated Bible，这是一个更全面、现代的手工圣经，并强调其艺术性和独特性（如耶稣穿牛仔裤），指出其与普通书籍的区别。
• [ForOldHack] 分享个人经历，自幼对书法和 illuminated manuscript 感兴趣，曾在 Getty 博物馆观赏相关展览并沉迷其中。
• [rdtsc] 分享某艺术家的作品链接，并提到该艺术家创作的 illuminated psalter（诗篇），该作品只能通过特别订单获取。
• [karaokeyoga] 提供维基百科上关于 illuminated manuscript 的参考链接。
• [anothereng] 表示希望看到天主教版本的 illuminated manuscript。
• [AStonesThrow] 对 illuminated manuscript 的价格感到惊讶，认为仅售35英镑似乎过于便宜，质疑其珍贵性。
• [BiteCode_dev] 提出如果文章讨论的是 illuminated 版本的《古兰经》，是否还能登上 Hacker News 首页，质疑在技术社区讨论宗教经典是否合适。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于 illuminated manuscript 的价格与其实际价值和珍贵性之间的关系，[AStonesThrow] 对低价表示怀疑，而其他人则关注手稿的艺术和历史价值。
• [BiteCode_dev] 提出的宗教中立性问题引发对在技术论坛讨论宗教相关内容的反思，但未形成直接争论。
• 讨论还涉及 illuminated manuscript 的现代诠释，如 St. John’s Illuminated Bible 和 Robert Crumb 的《创世纪》漫画，这些作品如何在当代文化中传承和创新 illuminated manuscript 的艺术形式。

data.title: UN says scam call centers are epidemic and expanding globally
data.author: jnord
data.article_summary: 联合国警告称，诈骗电话中心问题曾主要集中在东南亚，但如今已演变为全球性问题。随着东南亚各国加大打击力度，犯罪集团正将业务转移到南美、中东、非洲和南亚等监管薄弱的地区，甚至扩展至欧洲和北美。这些诈骗团伙通过贩运人口扩大业务，年获利达274亿至365亿美元。例如，2024年在赞比亚的一次行动中，警方逮捕了77名嫌疑人，其中包括22名中国公民。同时，格鲁吉亚首都第比利斯也成为网络诈骗的新热点，一个犯罪团伙自2022年5月以来诈骗了超过6000名受害者，涉案金额达3500万美元。全球诈骗网络正迅速扩展，威胁各国主权和政府系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何应对垃圾和诈骗电话问题，特别是在印度及其他国家日益猖獗的背景下，讨论涉及技术公司、政府监管、个人解决方案等多个方面。

不同观点：
• **政府监管不力与历史问题**：sometimes_all 认为印度的垃圾和诈骗电话问题已经非常严重，尽管政府正在采取行动，但为时已晚。腐败和政府部门技术能力的缺乏使得问题在过去十多年间没有得到有效遏制。目前虽然有一些工具（如Google的防垃圾功能、Truecaller等）和投诉渠道，但效果有限。

Cyber-crime

UN says Asian scam call center epidemic expanding globally amid political heat
7
What used to be a serious issue mainly in Southeast Asia is now the world’s problem
Connor Jones
Tue 22 Apr 2025
//
15:15 UTC
Scam call centers are metastasizing worldwide "like a cancer," according to the United Nations, which warns the epidemic has reached a global inflection point as syndicates scale up and spread out.
Recent crackdowns in East and Southeast Asia - where scam centers took root at industrial scale - have coincided with organized criminal groups (OCGs) shifting operations to more permissive regions.
The UN's ongoing tracking of scam call center operators, which often traffic vulnerable people to work on the front lines of the enterprise, revealed a growing number of operations emerging in regions beyond Southeast Asia.
Previous UN reports flagged growing activity in regions like South America and the Middle East. The latest update expands that scope, citing overseas crackdowns and evidence of scam operations tied to Southeast Asian crime syndicates in Africa, South Asia, select Pacific islands, and links to related criminal services—such as laundering and recruitment—as far as Europe, North America, and beyond.
These spillover sites, as the UN calls them, allow Asian OCGs to expand their pool of victims by hiring/trafficking locals with different language skills and "dramatically scale up profits," according to the UN's latest
report
[PDF].
"We are seeing a global expansion of East and Southeast Asian organized crime groups," said Benedikt Hofmann, acting regional representative for Southeast Asia and the Pacific at the UN's Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC).
"This reflects both a natural expansion as the industry grows and seeks new ways and places to do business, but also a hedging strategy against future risks should disruption continue and intensify in the region."
Previously, the hotspots for this type of activity have been in places like
Myanmar
, Cambodia, the Philippines, and Laos since 2021 when the UN and Interpol started tracking the phenomenon.
Authorities treat it in one area, but the roots never disappear; they simply migrate
"It spreads like a cancer," Hofmann added. "Authorities treat it in one area, but the roots never disappear; they simply migrate. This has resulted in a situation in which the region has essentially become an interconnected ecosystem, driven by sophisticated syndicates freely exploiting vulnerabilities, jeopardizing state sovereignty, and distorting and corrupting policy-making processes and other government systems and institutions."
The UN said these scam gangs typically relocate to jurisdictions with weak governance, allowing them to expand operations—and rake in between $27.4 and $36.5 billion annually, according to estimates based on labour force size and average haul per scammer.
UNODC notes that scam operations tied to Southeast Asia have surfaced in several African countries, where local law enforcement has launched raids leading to arrests of suspected foreign nationals involved in fraud and cybercrime.
Thailand ready to welcome 7,000 trafficked scam call center victims back from Myanmar
READ MORE
The UN org said 77 suspects were arrested during one bust of a fraud syndicate in Zambia in April 2024. Those nabbed included 22 Chinese nationals, who were later handed sentences of up to 11 years. Similar scenes played out in Angola, Nigeria, and more.
Reliable data is harder to come by in South America, but the UN notes growing signs that some Asian criminal groups are scaling up online fraud and gambling infrastructure aimed at the region—alongside efforts to forge money laundering partnerships with local drug trafficking networks. In a few isolated cases, they've even managed to establish physical scam operations on the ground.
In Europe, in addition to Russia, which has its own unique affiliation with cybercrime, Georgia and Turkey have emerged as hotspots for digital fraud in recent times.
The UN pointed to a large operation in Georgian capital city Tbilisi exposed by journalists and investigation groups in March 2025 as an example of how robust criminal networks have become in the region.
One
call center
in Tbilisi, uncovered in March 2025, had allegedly pulled in over $35 million from more than 6,000 victims worldwide since May 2022, though the UN notes there's limited evidence tying this particular operation to Asian criminal networks.

data.title: Mike Wood, Whose LeapFrog Toys Taught a Generation, Dies at 72
data.author: nxobject
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Leapfrog玩具（特别是Leap Pads和其他相关电子玩具）的评价与争议

不同观点：
• MarkusWandel认为Leapfrog的玩具（尤其是"run apps" LCD屏幕类）虽然在应用程序方面采用的是剃刀-刀片商业模式（即硬件便宜，软件昂贵），但其工程设计非常出色。他特别提到"Rockit Twist"和"Scribble and Write"的功能性和耐用性，认为这些玩具在工程设计上值得称赞。

• andrehacker对Fly pentop、Fly Fusion电脑以及Livescribe模型给予高度评价，认为它们曾是非常出色的产品。然而，随着智能手机的普及，这些玩具和工具逐渐失去了原有的用途，尤其是对于手写功能的依赖减少。他还提到Fly Fusion目前仅能在连接到已不存在的网站时才能完全发挥功能。

• seanalltogether指出，尽管现在有便宜的Android平板电脑，但其年幼的孩子仍然喜欢使用Leapfrog pads。他认为这种物理笔和书本的交互方式提供了平板电脑无法替代的触觉反馈和控制感。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是Leapfrog玩具的性价比和应用程序的高昂价格。MarkusWandel认为应用程序的价格相对于其功能显得过于昂贵，但同时对其工程设计表示赞赏。
• andrehacker对智能手机普及后这些玩具的实用性提出了质疑，认为其逐渐失去了市场竞争力。
• seanalltogether则从用户体验的角度出发，强调了Leapfrog pads在物理交互和触觉反馈方面的独特优势，即使在平板电脑普及的时代，这种交互方式仍然具有吸引力。

总的来说，讨论围绕Leapfrog玩具的工程设计、性价比、以及在现代科技环境下的实用性和吸引力展开。不同用户根据自己的使用经验和观察，提供了多样化的观点和评价。

data.title: Subnanosecond Flash Memory
data.author: thund
data.article_summary: 本文报道了一种基于二维材料的闪存，通过二维增强热载流子注入机制，实现了400皮秒的编程速度，超越了传统闪存的速度限制。该闪存利用了二维Dirac石墨烯通道，支持电子和空穴注入，具有非易失性和超过550万次循环的耐久性。通过优化水平电场分布，注入电流提升至60.4 pA/μm，且二维半导体二硒化钨展现出不同的热空穴注入行为。该技术突破了非易失性内存的速度瓶颈，甚至超过了最快的高速静态随机存取存储器（SRAM），为未来高性能计算提供了可能。尽管如此，新兴内存技术仍面临诸如热干扰、缩放困难等挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新开发的皮秒级闪存设备的有效性、耐久性以及在实际应用中的限制。

不同观点：
• **userbinator** 对闪存设备的耐久性和数据保留能力表示怀疑。他们指出，文章中提到的10年和550万次循环的耐久性数据缺乏清晰的保留曲线，可能存在只关注耐久性而忽视数据保留的问题。他们还提到了一项关于USB驱动器耐久性测试的研究，该研究同样忽视了数据保留问题。

• **bob1029** 关注的是即使有了瞬时内存，如何在物理距离上进行有效通信仍然是个问题。他们质疑为什么L1缓存的大小受到限制，并讨论了是否有可能任意扩展缓存大小。

• **thund** 引用了文章中的技术数据，强调该闪存设备具有400皮秒的编程速度和超过550万次循环的耐久性，认可该设备的性能和潜力。

• **ein0p** 提出将计算单元与闪存设备 colocate（共置），通过使用小芯片完全绕过内存总线和PCIe，以解决内存带宽和容量瓶颈问题，认为这是实现理想Transformer基质的途径。

补充讨论：
• **kvemkon** 提供了一个相关讨论的链接，涉及研究人员开发皮秒级闪存设备的新闻，为讨论提供了背景信息。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于闪存设备的耐久性和数据保留能力是否如文章所述那样优越。userbinator指出耐久性测试可能忽略了数据保留，这引发了对设备实际应用效果的质疑。

• bob1029对物理距离通信的关注以及对缓存扩展限制的疑问，也引发了对该设备在实际系统中应用潜力的讨论。

43740803.article_summary: 本文报道了一种基于二维材料的闪存，通过二维增强热载流子注入机制，实现了400皮秒的编程速度，超越了传统闪存的速度限制。该闪存利用了二维Dirac石墨烯通道，支持电子和空穴注入，具有非易失性和超过550万次循环的耐久性。通过优化水平电场分布，注入电流提升至60.4 pA/μm，且二维半导体二硒化钨展现出不同的热空穴注入行为。该技术突破了非易失性内存的速度瓶颈，甚至超过了最快的高速静态随机存取存储器（SRAM），为未来高性能计算提供了可能。尽管如此，新兴内存技术仍面临诸如热干扰、缩放困难等挑战。

data.article_summary:
这篇文章主要介绍了对Godot引擎添加对Apple visionOS平台支持的初步贡献。贡献来自Apple的visionOS工程团队，目标包括支持现有的Godot游戏在visionOS上运行，以及通过新的Godot visionOS VR插件创建沉浸式体验。贡献分为三个增量PR：

1. 添加原生visionOS平台，基于iOS平台，重用大量代码，引入新的`drivers/apple_embedded`文件夹以共享iOS和visionOS代码。
2. 增加编译和链接Swift文件的能力，替换visionOS平台上的`main.mm`以支持SwiftUI应用生命周期，这是实现沉浸式场景的必要条件。
3. 引入Vision Pro VR插件以支持沉浸式体验。

团队请求社区对文档和测试提供进一步指导和反馈，并表示愿意根据反馈进行迭代修改。目前的测试主要使用Platformer演示项目，验证了在iOS和visionOS上的运行情况。

Dear Godot community,
I'm on Apple's visionOS engineering team, and we would like to contribute Vision Pro support to the Godot engine. This is the first PR that lays the foundation for that.
First, I'd like to mention that we're really excited to be working with the Godot community on adding visionOS support. We've attempted to follow Godot's coding standards and a high-quality bar for our contributions. We hope that our contributions align with Godot's goals. Lastly, even though we have tried to split the changes into smaller self-contained PRs, we acknowledge that some of these PRs can be of considerable size.
We're very happy to iterate on our PRs after receiving feedback and suggestions from the community.
High Level Overview
The immediate goals of our contributions are:
To support current Godot games running natively on a planar window on visionOS.
To support creating Immersive experiences by using a new Godot's visionOS VR Plugin.
To achieve that, and in order to make reviewing easier, we have structured our contributions in three incremental PRs.
Add the native
visionOS
platform. Uses iOS as the starting point. Reuses as much code as possible between the iOS and Vision Pro platforms. (This PR).
Add ability to compile and link Swift files within Godot, and replace
main.mm
on the
visionOS
platform by the SwiftUI app lifecycle. This is a requirement to be able to launch Immersive scenes on visionOS.
Introduce Vision Pro VR plugin for Immersive support.
Even though we have a working version including points 2 and 3, those PRs are not up yet. Our current plan is to open them sequentially, after each of the previous PRs merge.
Technical Discussion
This PR implements a new native
visionOS
platform.
It's very close to the
iOS
platform in terms of implementation. In order to reuse as much code as possible, it introduces a new
drivers/apple_embedded
folder, to host code shared between the
iOS
and
visionOS
(but not
macOS
) platforms. We took inspiration from the new
drivers/apple
folder, which hosts code that applies to all Apple platforms.
The platform-specific logic (including app instantiation, client code, display server, os support, and export plugin) was refactored, and now the bulk of the implementation is on
drivers/apple_embedded
. The platforms provide small subclasses that specialize the concrete aspects that are different between platforms. We did this refactor with care, trying not to alter the existing iOS functionality.
The
visionOS
platform doesn't have OpenGL support, as it's not supported by visionOS.
In order to make reviewing easier, we have tried to split this PR into individual self-contained commits when that made sense, and we have added detailed descriptions to most of them about what's contained in each commit. It's easier to review commit by commit, to see how the changes were incrementally implemented.
Documentation Considerations
Now, the export plugin for
iOS
and
visionOS
share the majority of the code and most of their options (with the exception of launch storyboard support, which is iOS only; and specific platform icon support). Because of this, we have renamed
EditorExportPlatformIOS.xml
to
EditorExportPlatformAppleEmbedded.xml
, and moved it to
drivers/apple_embedded
.
We'd like to ask the community if this is appropriate from the docs tooling perspective, and we're requesting further guidance on how to modify this file or the docs tooling to provide specific documentation for each of the platforms.
Testing
We have been testing this PR mainly with the
Platformer demo project
. We have verified the project continues to work on iOS, and it now runs natively on visionOS. We have tested both the Mobile and Forward+ renderers with the Metal rendering driver on both platforms.
Open Questions
In all our tests, we exported an Xcode project using the corresponding export plugin and template, and we then ran this project directly to an iOS or visionOS device.

data.title: The Value of Differences: Jennifer Lindsay on Noticing Translation
data.author: Thevet
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了国际文学奖项和书评对翻译作品的关注增加，特别是国际布克奖对提升译者地位的贡献。尽管译者获得更多认可，但翻译艺术本身仍未得到足够重视。文章指出，虽然译者变得更加可见，但翻译过程却被忽视。国际布克奖主要奖励英文翻译作品，且倾向于新出版的书籍，限制了经典或再翻译作品的参与。尽管译者与作者共同获奖，但媒体和奖项宣传更强调书籍本身的品质，而忽略了翻译的独特性。文章质疑这种趋势是否真正提升了人们对翻译的理解和 appreciation。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：翻译的质量和方法，尤其是在人工与AI翻译之间的选择和其影响

不同观点：
• **nestorD 的观点**：翻译工作需要高度的专业技能，而不仅仅是语言知识。很多非 fiction 和部分 fiction 的翻译读起来感觉明显是翻译过来的，这提醒我们翻译不仅仅是简单的语言转换，更是一种专业技能的体现。

• **jbjbjbjb 的观点**：不希望阅读那些“感觉不到原语言存在”的翻译作品，尤其是成语等部分，希望原语言的特色能被展现和庆祝，而不是完全被“抹平”。

• **makeitdouble 的观点**：提到了传统上关于“翻译”与“改编”的讨论，认为目前存在一种偏见，认为翻译是学术性的、过于挑剔，限制了创作自由。同时指出，自动翻译虽然让语言障碍变得不那么重要，但并不意味着它足够好。过于依赖自动翻译可能会忽略掉原作真正想表达的内容。

• **jillesvangurp 的观点**：认为AI翻译已经变得非常实用，尤其是在法律文件和网站本地化方面。尽管有时需要人工检查和修正，但总体上已经达到了可以信任的水平。AI翻译的进步使得翻译效率大大提高，未来可能会有大量由AI辅助的图书翻译出现。同时，提到原作者可能不愿意因为低质量的翻译而误解他们的作品，但有些作者可能会为了扩大读者群而选择自我出版翻译作品。

补充讨论：
• **neom 的观点**：通过讨论提到了一位具体的翻译者Sharon Choi，可能是在暗示优秀翻译者的才华和其在翻译中的重要性。

• **争议焦点**：人工翻译和AI翻译的质量以及其在不同领域的适用性。一方认为AI翻译虽然方便但可能忽略了原文的细微之处，另一方则认为AI翻译已经足够好，尤其是在效率和成本上具有优势。翻译中如何平衡原语言特色和目标语言的自然表达也是一个值得注意的争议点。

43755682.article_content:
Info
Topics
On translation
,
Literary criticism
Writers
Jennifer Lindsay
Footnotes
Full disclosure here: I have twice been short-listed for this prize, and once invited to be on the jury, which I declined.
My time frame was not rigid, as the number of issues per year vary:
NYRB
20;
LRB
24;
ABR
11. I extended the time frame for the
ABR
to 2022-2023 to make it more equivalent.
International literary prizes and book reviews are increasingly acknowledging the importance of translated work. However, as Jennifer Lindsay argues, while translators themselves are receiving acclaim, their art remains largely underappreciated.
Translators are usually passionate about language - their own and others’ - and about other places. You don’t sink into a translation project, which can take at least a year or two out of your life, to get attention or to earn big money. Appreciation is satisfying, though - not necessarily for oneself, but for the art. Translation prizes and book reviews are where you expect such appreciation to be found. Someone noticed.
When in 2015 the Booker Prize Foundation announced that, from 2016 onwards, the Man Booker International Prize, which had been awarded every second year to an author for their entire body of work, was to be reborn as the International Booker Prize for fiction in translation, translators welcomed this as a sign of growing appreciation for their art. The generous prize money of £50,000 for a single book was to be shared between translator and author. So far, nine awards have been given – to books originally written in Korean, Hebrew, Polish, Arabic, Dutch, French, Hindi, Bulgarian and German. Their translators have received acclaim, and the prize has helped other translators step out from invisibility. Increasingly, they are credited, named on book covers, sought by publishers, and receive better contractual terms. The IBP has also influenced other translation prizes worldwide.
But how much have things really progressed? While the International Booker might have heralded a rise in the status of literary translators, is there a commensurate deepening of appreciation for, and understanding of, translation itself? While translators are being made more visible, is translation being made more invisible?
What is it that gets rewarded, targeted, and neglected by translation prizes? Let us stay with the International Booker. The prize is limited to books translated into English. (For the sake of comparison, a study of international prizes for translation into languages other than English is sorely needed). Entries must be books published (or co-published) in the UK or Ireland, and submissions be made by publishers. The translation must have been published within a one-year period (May-April) prior to the closing date. The prize is annual.
In its 2021 press release, the Prize
stated
that its aim is ‘to encourage more reading of quality fiction from all over the world’. So far, so good, but that noble aim is significantly qualified when the criteria are scrutinised. First, it is clearly a prize intended to encourage British publishers to publish more literature in translation. They submit entries not just because of an altruistic motive of nurturing translation, but also because a win or a short-list nomination significantly lifts sales. Fair enough. Second, the prize – like the main Booker Prize, which is awarded to an original work of fiction written in English – targets recent books. For the International Booker, however,
both
author and translator must be living at the time of submission, thereby favouring books that are also recently published in their original language. In short, the English language publisher is looking for a ‘new book’. Third, while I could find no explicit stipulation on this, the prize does not appear to promote re-translations. Clearly, this disqualifies a lot of international ‘quality fiction’.
When I accessed the Booker Prizes website in December 2024, it
stressed
the equivalence of the Booker Prize and the International Booker Prize:
The symmetrical relationship between the Booker Prize and the International Booker Prize ensures that the Booker honours fiction on a global basis: world-class fiction is highlighted by the prizes for English-speaking readers, whether that work was originally written in English (the Booker Prize) or translated into English (the International Booker Prize).
Media releases for the IBP winners also stress ‘this symmetrical relationship’, blurring the uniqueness of translated work, and, one might say, blurring translation. Despite the elevation of the translator to co-prizewinner, translation itself appears almost incidental. I am struck by how little specific comment there is on it. The emphasis is on ‘the book’ – new, disturbing, pathbreaking, original, lyrical, shocking, powerful, or beautiful. It is almost as though translation is downplayed in order for the book to be accepted as something on par with fiction originally written

主要讨论点：翻译的质量和方法，尤其是在人工与AI翻译之间的选择和其影响

不同观点：
• **nestorD 的观点**：翻译工作需要高度的专业技能，而不仅仅是语言知识。很多非 fiction 和部分 fiction 的翻译读起来感觉明显是翻译过来的，这提醒我们翻译不仅仅是简单的语言转换，更是一种专业技能的体现。

• **jbjbjbjb 的观点**：不希望阅读那些“感觉不到原语言存在”的翻译作品，尤其是成语等部分，希望原语言的特色能被展现和庆祝，而不是完全被“抹平”。

• **makeitdouble 的观点**：提到了传统上关于“翻译”与“改编”的讨论，认为目前存在一种偏见，认为翻译是学术性的、过于挑剔，限制了创作自由。同时指出，自动翻译虽然让语言障碍变得不那么重要，但并不意味着它足够好。过于依赖自动翻译可能会忽略掉原作真正想表达的内容。

• **jillesvangurp 的观点**：认为AI翻译已经变得非常实用，尤其是在法律文件和网站本地化方面。尽管有时需要人工检查和修正，但总体上已经达到了可以信任的水平。AI翻译的进步使得翻译效率大大提高，未来可能会有大量由AI辅助的图书翻译出现。同时，提到原作者可能不愿意因为低质量的翻译而误解他们的作品，但有些作者可能会为了扩大读者群而选择自我出版翻译作品。

补充讨论：
• **neom 的观点**：通过讨论提到了一位具体的翻译者Sharon Choi，可能是在暗示优秀翻译者的才华和其在翻译中的重要性。

• **争议焦点**：人工翻译和AI翻译的质量以及其在不同领域的适用性。一方认为AI翻译虽然方便但可能忽略了原文的细微之处，另一方则认为AI翻译已经足够好，尤其是在效率和成本上具有优势。翻译中如何平衡原语言特色和目标语言的自然表达也是一个值得注意的争议点。

data.title: The Gruen Transfer is consuming the internet
data.author: Incerto
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了“Gruen Transfer”现象，即商家通过故意设计的混乱布局，使消费者忘记最初购物目的，从而进行更多冲动购买。这种策略最初出现在实体店，但现在也蔓延到了互联网，尤其是在社交媒体和各种网站上。例如，Facebook的动态 feed 本意是简化好友更新，但现在充满了广告和无关内容，使用户迷失初始目标。许多网站通过复杂设计让用户迷失方向，甚至在取消账户或修改服务时设置障碍，采用“黑暗模式”使用户难以达成目的。文章还提到欧盟立法要求取消订阅的复杂度应与订阅一致，以减少不必要的复杂性对用户的困扰。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Gruen Transfer效应在不同平台上的体现及用户反应

不同观点：
• Tepix认为Amazon的搜索功能糟糕，常常混杂不相关的结果，导致他误买商品。他更喜欢如geizhals.at这样允许详细筛选的网站。
• frereubu认为Wikipedia的例子不恰当，因为这种行为并非故意设计，而是用户习惯使然，类似于过去的物理百科全书浏览体验。
• jhbadger指出文章未提及Victor Gruen，他是Gruen Transfer概念的来源，相关讨论应参考其背景。
• moomin认为许多复杂的交互设计反而让他选择放弃使用，且没有重大损失。
• hk__2认为Wikipedia的设计并非为了迷惑用户，只是一个正常的带有链接的网站。
• jalk将类似体验称为“IKEA迷宫”，并举例哥本哈根机场免税店的设计。
• keiferski认为这种现象在任何系统中都是不可避免的，尤其是当用户需求新颖性时，例如Facebook的时间线设计。
• netsharc提到在Stack Exchange网站上，他会屏蔽“Hot network questions”和cookie弹窗。
• dmazin分享了自己在使用智能手机和Instagram时的迷失体验，原本只是想发消息，最终却 scroll 了很久。
• eptcyka坚称Wikipedia的设计与Gruen Transfer无关。
• furyg3简单总结为广告正在毁掉一切。
• dingaling对Facebook的体验不同，他的feed主要由朋友的更新组成，偶尔有些推荐。
• benterix询问是否有浏览器插件可以过滤未订阅的内容，怀疑Meta不会允许这种操作。
• mensetmanusman和cheschire提到使用ChatGPT来替代传统网络浏览和购物体验。

• 对于Wikipedia是否属于Gruen Transfer的讨论存在争议，一部分人认为用户的行为习惯使然，而非网站设计故意迷惑。

The Gruen Transfer is consuming the internet
Have you ever walked into a supermarket, pharmacy, or department store looking to buy a specific item, only to find the layout confusing? Perhaps you ended up aimlessly strolling around, purchasing other items? This is deliberate, and known as the Gruen Transfer.
The 'Transfer' part is the moment that you, as a consumer surrounded by a deliberately confusing layout, lose track of your original intentions.
We've all experienced it, and now it's starting to consume the internet. It first appeared on Facebook, with the introduction of the feed. Originally intended as a way to simplify updates from your friends, and hold your attention captive for longer. However somewhere along the line, the feed became more than that. Facebook now feels more confusing than my local department store, and my original reason for visiting (keeping up to date with friends & family) is quickly forgotten. The last time I checked Facebook, maybe 10% of my feed was updates from friends. The rest was a combination of ads, memes, and influencer marketing videos, leaving me doom scrolling endlessly.
This isn't relegated to Facebook though, or even social media. So many websites are now designed to disorient you upon visiting, so that you start acting impulsively. This can even happen in a relatively benign way - who hasn't looked up something on Wikipedia and fell down a rabbit hole that ended looking at a
list of animals awarded human credentials
?
It pops up in other areas as well, closely associated with several UX dark patterns. If you've tried to permanently delete your account from any major social network, youâll know what I mean. It is utterly confusing to find and navigate to the page you need, and the site will desperately conjole you into doing something other than deleting your account. It's the same for trying to alter your insurance policy, cancel subscriptions, spend frequent flyer miles, and so on...
I wonder where all this will end? There must be a point at which the friction generated by needless complexity has a detrimental effect. A kind of
Laffer Curve
of web design.
In the EU, it is a legal requirement to allow your customers the same method, with the same number of steps and complexity, for canceling as for subscribing. So if it takes 10 seconds to fill in a form online to get subscribed, they need to offer the same ease of use for canceling.
I like this idea of âcomplexityâ as a measure for legislation. Now if only they could apply the same thing to my local Boots when I'm trying to buy toothpaste.

data.title: Hyperscaling Have I Been Pwned with Cloudflare Workers and Caching
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：HIBP（Have I Been Pwned）服务的可用性及技术改进建议

不同观点：
• [randunel] 认为HIBP对第三世界国家的人已经无法使用，因为无尽的CF（Cloudflare）验证码循环让访问变得困难。他提供了一个图片链接以展示问题。
• [benlivengood] 提出了一种技术改进方案，建议通过版本控制和按前缀逐步引导流量到新版本，以减少对服务的影响，具体方法是根据Unix时间戳逐步推出新版本。
• [rokkamokka] 认为如果可以直接将更新数据推送到缓存，而无需刷新缓存，可能会大幅减少对源服务器的依赖，从而提高效率。
• [charcircuit] 建议将数据公开转储，让用户无需通过服务查询即可获取隐私信息。他还对目前获取信息的隐秘性表示不满，认为Telegram等非公开渠道不应该成为唯一选择。
• [gnabgib] 的评论简短，仅标注了年份（2024），没有提出具体观点或建议。
• [mschuster91] 讨论了用户对响应速度的误解，指出由于很多网站和应用的缓慢表现，当一个系统真正快速响应时，用户反而会怀疑其有效性。他批评了现代软件开发中的一些不良实践（如Electron和大型JS包）导致的延迟问题。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于HIBP服务的可用性和技术架构的改进。具体包括CF验证码对用户体验的影响、版本控制和流量引导的技术细节、缓存更新的可能性，以及数据公开与隐私保护之间的平衡。
- [randunel] 和 [benlivengood] 之间存在实际问题的识别和解决方案的讨论，前者指出问题，后者提供具体技术建议。
- [charcircuit] 的观点引发了对隐私保护和数据公开的讨论，涉及如何平衡透明度和用户隐私。
- [mschuster91] 的评论则提出了对现代软件开发实践的批判，认为快速响应本应是理想标准，而非例外。

data.title: Why Does My eBPF Program Work on One Kernel but Fail on Another?
data.author: musha68k
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Linux内核数据结构和API的稳定性及其对开发者的影响

不同观点：
• [kazinator] 认为 "struct tcphdr" 的结构在Linux内核从5.3到5.4版本之间没有变化，也不应该变化，因为改变会违反TCP协议的RFC标准，导致互操作性问题。他提供了相关内核源代码的链接来支持他的观点。

• [musicale] 则持不同意见，认为内核数据结构和API的不稳定性会给eBPF、驱动程序和内核扩展的开发者带来额外的维护负担。他指出，系统模块和平台应该通过承受改变的痛苦来使广大用户和开发者受益，而不是反过来增加开发者的负担。他还提到iOS平台每年都会破坏用户应用程序，增加了开发者的维护成本。

• [Upvoter33] 提供了一个研究链接，指出该话题已有相关研究，但没有详细阐述其立场。

• [linuxftw] 补充说明eBPF文档中已经涵盖了相关内容，指出CORE在六年前就已经引入，暗示对相关变化已有较长时间的适应和文档支持。

• [jstrong] 简单表达了对处理这些变化的困扰，但没有深入讨论。

• [jeffrallen] 认为这是“基础设施代码过度变动导致的必要复杂性”的另一个例子，并质疑为什么没有关于dtrace探针的文章。他推测可能是因为dtrace探针使用较少、能力较差、更稳定或工程质量更好。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Linux内核API和ABI的稳定性，以及这种不稳定性对不同类型开发者的影响。
• 讨论中提到了与其他平台（如iOS）的对比，强调了不同平台在API稳定性上的不同策略及其影响。
• 对eBPF等新技术文档和历史变化的提及，提供了对该话题的更深入理解。
• 对不同工具（如dtrace探针和eBPF）的比较，提出了可能影响稳定性和使用频率的因素。

data.author: BerislavLopac
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了14个高级Python技巧，旨在帮助开发者充分利用Python的强大功能。这些技巧包括类型重载（Typing Overloads）、仅关键字和仅位置参数（Keyword-only and Positional-only Arguments）、未来注解（Future Annotations）、泛型（Generics）、协议（Protocols）等。文章详细解释了每个技巧的用法，例如使用`@overload`装饰器定义多个函数签名以实现类型检查，通过仅关键字和仅位置参数控制函数参数传递方式，以及利用字符串字面量进行类型安全检查等。每个技巧都附有示例代码和额外资源链接，帮助读者深入理解。这些技巧最初是在3月1日至3月14日间通过X/Twitter系列发布，并提供了Nitter镜像链接以保护隐私。

43769486.article_content:
Python is one of the
most widely adopted programming languages
in the world. Yet, because of it’s ease and simplicity to just “get
something
working”, it’s also one of the most underappreciated.
If you search for
Top 10 Advanced Python Tricks
on Google or any other search engine, you’ll find tons of blogs or LinkedIn articles going over trivial (but still useful) things like
generators
or
tuples
.
However
, as someone who’s written Python for the past 12 years, I’ve come across a lot of really interesting, underrated, unique, or (as some might say) “un-pythonic” tricks to
really
level up what Python can do.
That’s why I decided to compile the top 14 of said features alongside examples and additional resources if you want to dive deeper into any of them.
These tips & tricks were originally featured as part of a 14-day series on X/Twitter between March 1st and March 14th (pi-day, hence why there are 14 topics in the article).
All X/Twitter links will also be accompanied with a Nitter counterpart. Nitter is a privacy-abiding open source Twitter frontend. Learn more about the project
here
.
Table of Contents
1. Typing Overloads
2. Keyword-only and Positional-only Arguments
3. Future Annotations
4. Generics
5. Protocols
6. Context Managers
7. Structural Pattern Matching
8. Python Slots
9. Python Nitpicks
10. Advanced f-string String Formatting
11. Cache / lru_cache
12. Python Futures
13. Proxy Properties
14. Metaclasses
1. Typing Overloads
Original X/Twitter Thread
|
Nitter Mirror
@overload
is a decorator from Python’s
typing
module that lets you define multiple signatures for the same function. Each overload tells the type checker exactly what types to expect when specific parameters are passed in.
For example, the code below dictates that
only
list[str]
can be returned if
mode=split
, and
only
str
can be returned if
mode=upper
. (The
Literal
type also forces mode to be either one of
split
or
upper
)
from
typing
import
Literal, overload
@overload
def
transform
(data: str, mode: Literal[
"split"
])
->
list[str]:
...
@overload
def
transform
(data: str, mode: Literal[
"upper"
])
->
str:
...
def
transform
(data: str, mode: Literal[
"split"
,
"upper"
])
->
list[str]
|
str:
if
mode
==
"split"
:
return
data
.
split()
else
:
return
data
.
upper()
split_words
=
transform(
"hello world"
,
"split"
)
# Return type is list[str]
split_words[
0
]
# Type checker is happy
upper_words
=
transform(
"hello world"
,
"upper"
)
# Return type is str
upper_words
.
lower()
# Type checker is happy
upper_words
.
append(
"!"
)
# Cannot access attribute "append" for "str"
Overloads can do more than just change return type based on arguments! In another example, we use typing overloads to ensure that either one of
id
OR
username
are passed in, but
never both
.
@overload
def
get_user
(id: int
=
...
, username:
None
=
None
)
->
User:
...
@overload
def
get_user
(id:
None
=
None
, username: str
=
...
)
->
User:
...
def
get_user
(id: int
|
None
=
None
, username: str
|
None
=
None
)
->
User:
...
get_user(id
=
1
)
# Works!
get_user(username
=
"John"
)
# Works!
get_user(id
=
1
, username
=
"John"
)
# No overloads for "get_user" match the provided arguments
The
...
is a special value often used in overloads to indicate that a parameter is optional, but still requires a value.
â¨ Quick bonus trick:
As you probably saw, Python also has support for
String Literals
. These help assert that only specific string values can be passed to a parameter, giving you even more type safety. Think of them like a lightweight form of Enums!
def
set_color
(color: Literal[
"red"
,
"blue"
,
"green"
])
->
None
:
...
set_color(
"red"
)
set_color(
"blue"
)
set_color(
"green"
)
set_color(
"fuchsia"
)
# Argument of type "Literal['fuchsia']" cannot be assigned to parameter "color"
Additional Resources
Python Type Hints: How to use
@overload
PEP 3124 â Overloading, Generic Functions, Interfaces, and Adaptation
Python Docs - Overloads

2. Keyword-only and Positional-only Arguments
Original X/Twitter Thread
|
Nitter Mirror
By default, both required parameters and optional parameters can be assigned with both positional and keyword syntax. However, what if you
don’t
want that to happen?
Keyword-only and Positional-only args
let you control that.
def
foo
(a, b,
/
, c, d,
*
, e, f):
#         ^        ^
# Ever seen these before?
...
*
(asterisk)
marks keyword-only parameters. Arguments
after
*
must
be passed as keyword arguments.
#   KW+POS | KW ONLY
#       vv | vv
def
foo
(a,
*
, b):
...
# == ALLOWED ==
foo(a
=
1
, b
=
2
)
# All keyword
foo(
1
, b
=
2
)
# Half positional, half keyword
# == NOT ALLOWED ==
foo(
1
,
2
)
# Cannot use positional for keyword-only parameter
#      ^
/
(forward slash)
marks positional-only parameters. Arguments
before
/
must
be passed positionally and cannot be used as keyword arguments.
# POS ONLY | KW POS
#       vv | vv
def
bar
(a,
/
, b):
...
# == ALLOWED ==
bar(
1
,
2
)
# All positional
bar(
1
, b
=
2
)
# Half positional,

data.title: Open Source Projects Receive Funding to Reclaim the Public Internet
data.author: edent
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了42个自由和开源项目获得了NGI Zero Commons Fund的资助，旨在恢复互联网的公共性质。这些项目包括MNT Reform Touch开放硬件平板电脑、Solar FemtoTX超低功耗主板、Open Terms Archive对条款和条件的公开追踪、LLM2FPGA在FPGA上运行开源大语言模型以及bcachefs新一代Linux文件系统等。这些项目致力于改善技术，造福全人类，并推动互联网更加以人为本而非以利润为导向。文章还提醒申请人查看申请结果，并提供了部分项目的详细信息链接。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧盟资助开源项目以减少对美国科技公司的依赖，讨论涉及具体项目的效果、整体战略的缺乏以及资金分配的合理性。

不同观点：
• constantcrying：认为欧盟及其成员国投入资金支持各种项目，但未能解决最关键的问题，即缺乏能够与苹果或微软竞争的完整系统供应商。资金分散于许多小项目，而部署开源系统这一重大问题未得到解决。
• udev4096：指出一些核心和历史悠久的项目（如xz、libexpat、NetworkManager等）未被提及，认为这些项目是重新掌控开放互联网的基础，并质疑为何未支持如pihole和dnsmasq等项目。
• pickledoyster：支持某些具体项目（如PeerTube）的资助，但对资助Wiktionary表示质疑，因为Wikimedia已经拥有充足资金，且部分预算用于非核心项目。
• mixcocam：提到政府采购习惯也是一种间接资助形式，特别是在欧盟，政府采购规模巨大，对开源生态系统影响深远。
• tekchip：批评一些评论过于以美国为中心，指出欧洲的Canonical和Suse也具有重要影响力，并认为微软的“全面包揽”优势被夸大，特别是在后端主要由Linux运行的情况下。

补充讨论：
• maelito：认为Motis、Clearance和StreetComplete等自由映射社区项目获得资助是重要的积极信号。
• tasn、freetonik：基于自身经历对nlnet的资助工作表示赞赏，并提到一些受资助的具体项目（如SSH-Stamp、Marginalia搜索引擎）。
• ryao、MisterTea：对某些资助项目（如SSH-Stamp、Ada-bootstrap）缺乏项目页面和开发者信息表示困惑和关注。
• eichin：对“reclaim the public internet”的口号提出质疑，认为某些被资助项目（如太阳能主板、Ada bootstrapping）与这一目标关联不大。
• asim：指出许多小项目缺乏统一的愿景和战略，认为可能需要从协议层面重新开始，构建一个真正开放的云操作系统，目前离这一目标还很远。
• wolvesechoes：强调仅靠资金不足以解决问题，需要更高层次的计划和具体目标，认为“reclaim public internet”过于抽象，且自由软件在协调努力方面存在问题。
• b0dhimind：建议将许多资助项目添加到PortableApps中，以方便安装和更新。
• OsrsNeedsf2P：高度评价nlnet对Lemmy等项目的资助，认为这些项目是改变游戏规则的关键。

争议焦点：
1. 欧盟资助项目是否有效解决了对美国科技公司的依赖问题，特别是是否需要一个完整的系统供应商。
2. 具体资助项目的选择是否合理，一些评论者认为应优先考虑历史悠久的核心项目或其他特定项目。
3. “reclaim the public internet”这一目标是否过于抽象，是否需要更具体的战略和计划。
4. 某些资助项目缺乏透明度和开发者信息，引起部分评论者的质疑和关注。

To main content
Send in your ideas. Deadline June 1, 2025
42 Free and Open Source Projects Receive Funding to Reclaim the Public Nature of the Internet
It is wonderful to see the growing number of people working on digital commons, inventing and improving technologies to the benefit of all humanity. 42 of such projects have been selected for funding in the October call of the NGI Zero Commons Fund. In terms of applications, it was the largest call round in NGI Zero's life time. And we'd like to take this space to thank
all
applicants for their contributions to an internet for people rather than for profit.
The selected projects all contribute, one way or another, to the mission of the Commons Fund: reclaiming the public nature of the internet. For example, there are people working on
MNT Reform Touch
(an open hardware tablet device) and the
Solar FemtoTX motherboard
â a collaborative effort to create an ultra-low power motherboard that can run on solar power. The Open Terms Archive offers
public tracking of the evolution of terms and conditions
to facilitate democratic oversight.
LLM2FPGA
aims to enable running open source LLMs locally on FPGAs using a fully open-source toolchain.
bcachefs
readies itself as the next generation filesystem for Linux, improving performance, scalability and reliability when compared to legacy filesystems and
KDE Plasma Gestures
will add multi-touch and stroke gestures to the Plasma Desktop. And that's just a small sample of the wide range of important contributions being worked on. Read on to meet all the projects selected in this funding round.
If you applied for a grant
This is the selection for the
October call
of the NGI Zero Commons Fund fund only. We always inform
all
applicants about the outcome of the review ahead of the public announcement, whether they are selected or not. If you have not heard anything, you probably applied to a later call or a different fund that is still under review.
How do I find out which call round I applied to?
You can see which call round you applied to by checking the application number assigned to the project when you submitted the proposal. The number starts with the year and month of the call, so 2024-10- in the case of the October 2024 call. You see that same number featured in the emails we send you (It should not happen, but if you did apply to another call and did not hear anything, do contact us)
Meet the new projects!
(you can click or tap on the project name to fold out additional information)
Trustworthy hardware and manufacturing
FuseSoc-compatible Web Catalog
â A catalog of gateware that can be easily used with FuseSoC
FuseSoC is a package manager for chip designs, allowing for easy reuse and sharing of IP cores as well as combining them into larger systems. Its native core description format (CAPI2) allows describing IP cores in a tool- and vendor-independent way. Together with FuseSoC's backend library Edalize this enables creating and using portable IP cores and SoCs for a large number of EDA tools and flows.
This project will extend FuseSoC with a collaborative database and a web frontend that allows users to upload their core description files to a central repository to make it easier for others to find and inspect them. In addition, signing, SBOM generation and a web frontend will be added to increase transparency, trust and security.
â¸
For more details see
:
https://nlnet.nl/project/FuseSoC-catalog
MNT Reform Touch
â Open Hardware tablet device
The project summary for this project is not yet available. Please come back soon!
â¸

:
https://nlnet.nl/project/MNT-Reform-Touch
Solar FemtoTX motherboard with 802.3 cg Ethernet cards
â Low-power motherboard that can run on solar power
Solar FemtoTX motherboard with 802.3 cg Ethernet cards is an open, collaborative effort towards designing an ultra-low power motherboard in a mobile device-sized form factor. It aims to achieve several goals: 1) to design a plug and play (PnP) motherboard that can be seamlessly integrated into an open-source hardware laptop for easy repair/replacement/upgrade. 2) to utilize the new, 802.3cg ethernet standard for a low-power LAN port, and 3) to integrate the 802.3 cg ethernet port into a single board computer with a FemtoTX-sized form factor for the lowest power consumption, facilitating minimal solar energy requirements and quick recharging.
Furthermore, the project aims to make the open-hardware framework extensible by supporting socket-based or embedded processors and peripheral devices that meet a defined size and TDP limit. This interoperability allows newer, ultra low power microprocessors to work within the FemtoTX specification, and is optimized for solar power.

43769482.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧盟资助开源项目以减少对美国科技公司的依赖，讨论涉及具体项目的效果、整体战略的缺乏以及资金分配的合理性。

不同观点：
• constantcrying：认为欧盟及其成员国投入资金支持各种项目，但未能解决最关键的问题，即缺乏能够与苹果或微软竞争的完整系统供应商。资金分散于许多小项目，而部署开源系统这一重大问题未得到解决。
• udev4096：指出一些核心和历史悠久的项目（如xz、libexpat、NetworkManager等）未被提及，认为这些项目是重新掌控开放互联网的基础，并质疑为何未支持如pihole和dnsmasq等项目。
• pickledoyster：支持某些具体项目（如PeerTube）的资助，但对资助Wiktionary表示质疑，因为Wikimedia已经拥有充足资金，且部分预算用于非核心项目。
• mixcocam：提到政府采购习惯也是一种间接资助形式，特别是在欧盟，政府采购规模巨大，对开源生态系统影响深远。
• tekchip：批评一些评论过于以美国为中心，指出欧洲的Canonical和Suse也具有重要影响力，并认为微软的“全面包揽”优势被夸大，特别是在后端主要由Linux运行的情况下。

补充讨论：
• maelito：认为Motis、Clearance和StreetComplete等自由映射社区项目获得资助是重要的积极信号。
• tasn、freetonik：基于自身经历对nlnet的资助工作表示赞赏，并提到一些受资助的具体项目（如SSH-Stamp、Marginalia搜索引擎）。
• ryao、MisterTea：对某些资助项目（如SSH-Stamp、Ada-bootstrap）缺乏项目页面和开发者信息表示困惑和关注。
• eichin：对“reclaim the public internet”的口号提出质疑，认为某些被资助项目（如太阳能主板、Ada bootstrapping）与这一目标关联不大。
• asim：指出许多小项目缺乏统一的愿景和战略，认为可能需要从协议层面重新开始，构建一个真正开放的云操作系统，目前离这一目标还很远。
• wolvesechoes：强调仅靠资金不足以解决问题，需要更高层次的计划和具体目标，认为“reclaim public internet”过于抽象，且自由软件在协调努力方面存在问题。
• b0dhimind：建议将许多资助项目添加到PortableApps中，以方便安装和更新。

1. 欧盟资助项目是否有效解决了对美国科技公司的依赖问题，特别是是否需要一个完整的系统供应商。
2. 具体资助项目的选择是否合理，一些评论者认为应优先考虑历史悠久的核心项目或其他特定项目。
3. “reclaim the public internet”这一目标是否过于抽象，是否需要更具体的战略和计划。
4. 某些资助项目缺乏透明度和开发者信息，引起部分评论者的质疑和关注。

data.title: Pixel is a unit of length and area
data.author: anitil
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：像素的定义及其作为计量单位的性质

不同观点：
• **像素是计数单位**：Laremere认为像素应该被视为一种计数单位，类似于用物品的数量来描述长度，比如用街区的数量表示距离。这种表达是语言中的简化用法，在不清楚的语境下需要更多说明。
• **像素是物理实体**：otikik将像素比作浴室墙上的瓷砖，认为像素是物理实体，与尺寸和面积相关，而不单单是计数单位。
• **像素是点样本**：justin_引用Alvy Ray Smith的论文，强调像素是点样本，不能被视为小方块。这种观点强调像素在图像计算中的精确性。
• **像素不应作为长度单位**：RedNifre指出像素不应用作长度单位，建议使用Android的“dp”概念作为长度单位，以避免混淆。
• **像素是离散对象**：blenderob认为像素类似于点和苹果，是离散的对象，而不是像米一样的测量单位。强调像素在多行多列时的计数方式。
• **像素是二维的**：gilgoomesh认为像素本质上是二维的，具有面积单位。即使在信号处理中，像素也有面积密度。
• **像素定义依赖于实现**：ChrisMarshallNY提到像素的大小和形状依赖于具体实现，可能在不同设备上有所不同，甚至可以是非方形的。
• **像素具有时间属性**：rbanffy提到在8位计算机或模拟视频中，像素也可以是时间单位。
• **像素定义的复杂性**：ttoinou和fennecbutt认为像素的定义复杂多变，难以用单一固定的定义来概括。
• **像素与分辨率的关系**：Sharlin讨论了像素与分辨率的关系，指出像素在描述分辨率时的多维度性质，以及在不同情境下的不同意义。

补充讨论：
• **像素作为营销工具**：Sharlin提到相机制造商使用百万像素作为营销手段，以大数字吸引消费者。
• **像素和子像素**：讨论中提到像素内部结构（如子像素渲染）以及其在不同设备上的表现差异。
• **像素与棋盘类比**：knallfrosch用棋盘类比像素，强调像素在多维度空间中的计数方式。

争议焦点：
• **像素是否为计量单位**：像素是否应被视为长度单位或面积单位，或者仅仅是计数单位，存在不同看法。
• **像素的本质定义**：像素是点样本还是小方块，或是其他物理实体，各方观点不一。
• **像素在不同语境下的意义**：像素在不同应用场景（如图像处理、显示设备、相机分辨率）中的定义和使用方式存在分歧。

data.title: The Ghosts of Gaelic
data.author: apollinaire
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了苏格兰盖尔语和文化的现状及未来希望。2025年是《2005年盖尔语法案》通过20周年，该法案旨在确保盖尔语作为苏格兰官方语言与英语平等受尊重。尽管盖尔语使用者比例从2011年的1.7%上升到2022年的2.5%，但其向英语的转变已进入晚期。盖尔语不仅是一种语言，还承载着丰富的文化。文章还提及了18世纪詹姆斯·麦克弗森的《奥西恩》作品，虽然这些作品在欧洲广受欢迎并影响了浪漫主义，但其真实性备受争议。盖尔语和其文化的保护面临挑战，但通过学校、大学和应用程序的学习者数量在增加。文章强调了盖尔语对苏格兰民族身份的重要性和保护的必要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于如何保护和促进苏格兰盖尔语等少数语言的讨论，包括对现有问题、成功经验及未来方向的不同看法。

不同观点：
• Pete-Codes认为，盖尔语地区面临的最大问题是Airbnb和第二住宅的增加，导致当地社区被稀释，原住民外流，这影响了语言的生存环境。
• tsm认为文章过于关注过去，而忽视了未来的可能性。他指出了一些现代盖尔语的发展成就，如Gaelic-medium教育和媒体的发展，但也承认盖尔语社区的稀释和职业前景问题仍然是主要挑战。
• eamonnsullivan指出文章未提及其他类似语言的成功案例，如爱尔兰语和威尔士语，以及巴斯克语等其他少数语言，认为缺乏对这些经验的借鉴和对比。
• Peroni通过提到爱尔兰乐队Kneecap的例子，强调了现代文化产品对语言推广的作用，认为这种形式可以吸引新一代进入语言传统。
• defrost引用Brian O'Nolan的小说《The Poor Mouth》来讽刺对盖尔语文化的过度理想化和对贫困地区的忽视，提出对盖尔语文化真实性和实用性的质疑，并通过音乐示例展示了盖尔语的使用情况。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是如何平衡保护盖尔语传统文化和推动现代发展的关系。
• 另一个讨论点是是否应借鉴其他国家和地区保护少数语言的成功经验。
• 盖尔语社区的稀释和经济前景问题被普遍认为是语言保护的主要障碍。
• 现代文化产品和教育在语言推广中的作用被认为是值得关注和利用的策略。
• 对盖尔语文化的真实性和实用性的质疑提供了一个批判性视角，提醒人们注意理想化和现实之间的差距。

Behind the Times
The Ghosts of Gaelic
Gaelic language and culture in Scotland have a long history, often subsumed by English. Is there hope for their future?
Duncan Sneddon
| Published in
History Today
Volume 75 Issue 4 April 2025
A
pril 2025 is the 20th anniversary of the Gaelic Language Act (Scotland) of 2005, passed unanimously by the Scottish Parliament with the aim of ‘securing the status of the Gaelic language as an official language of Scotland commanding equal respect to the English language’. It has provided the main policy framework for Gaelic since then. Scottish language policy is set to be reshaped by the Scottish Languages Bill, currently working its way through Holyrood, which will give official status to both Gaelic and Scots. This gives occasion to reflect on the place of Gaelic in Scotland, on the relationship of what is now a minority language to the identity of a nation which has had ambiguous and conflicting relationships with Gaelic. What was until the 14th century the primary language of Scotland was, in the 2022 census, spoken by 2.5 per cent of the population (up from 1.7 per cent in 2011). Ever-greater numbers of people are learning the language in school and university or through apps such as Duolingo and the Speak Gaelic initiative, but the shift to English is now at an advanced stage even in the remaining communities with high proportions of Gaelic speakers, including in the Western Isles, Skye, and parts of the Inner Hebrides. The language has now effectively vanished from much of the country: when the language goes from a place, it is not just irregular verbs, syntax, and morphology that are lost, but also the culture that lived within that language, shared among the people who spoke it.
Macpherson and Ossian
Attempts to preserve or transmit Gaelic culture through English have, however, risked obscuring it entirely. Perhaps the most notorious example occurred in the 1760s, when the Gaelic-speaking Highlander James Macpherson published a series of works in English,
Fragments of Ancient Poetry
(1760),
Fingal
(1762), and
Temora
(1763), known collectively as
Ossian
after the ancient Gaelic bard whose works Macpherson claimed to be translating. The prose-poems, invariably about doomed heroes fighting bravely against overwhelming odds, abound in fog, clouds, blasts of wind through groaning trees: ‘The hills are troubled before the king! The dark woods echo round, and lighten at his steel. See him, amidst the foe, like Colgach’s sportful ghost when he scatters the clouds, and rides the eddying winds!’ This king, Fingal, is wise, brave in battle and magnanimous to friend and foe alike.
Ossian
became a runaway success across Europe, and was profoundly influential on the development of Romanticism in literature, art, and music. The heroes who bestrode his Highland landscapes became household names in Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and the Nordic countries as his works were translated, imitated, and adapted. Macpherson claimed to have been translating works he had collected from manuscripts and from travelling the Highlands transcribing poems that had survived orally. However, doubts sprang up almost immediately and detractors claimed
Ossian
was entirely his own creation. The debate played out in often bitter polemics for many years.
Ossian
is still primarily defined by the controversy over its authenticity. Much of the most influential ink on the matter was spilled by people such as Samuel Johnson in the 18th century, who absurdly claimed that there was no written Gaelic literature more than 100 years old, and Hugh Trevor-Roper in the 20th, whose ‘gross errors and excesses’ (per the Celticist Donald E. Meek) at least had the virtue of stimulating more informed commentary. Neither Johnson nor Trevor-Roper had any Gaelic, let alone familiarity with its heroic legendary traditions.
The controversy is often invoked in discussions of early modern nation-building.
Ossian
is a magnet for those interested in how Scotland came to understand itself in the 18th and 19th centuries and beyond. Indeed, from an English-speaking point of view it is easy to see
Ossian
as a bolt from the blue, an eccentric production emblematic of the anxieties and contradictions of post-Union and post-Culloden Scotland trying to articulate or invent an identity amid rapid and bewildering political, cultural, and economic change. There may be some fragments of folklore or ‘Celtic mythology’ (whatever that is, exactly) in there, but this must be taken on trust or rejected, and they are in any case difficult to assess.
From a Gaelic perspective, however, it is clear that
Ossian
is a manifestation of a well-attested tradition that existed long before and long after Macpherson’s time, albeit one which departs from the mainstream of that tradition in form, style, and content in many ways.
Finn MacCool

data.title: 'Nobody has done this before': Britain's beloved steam trains trial technology
data.author: beardyw
data.article_summary: 英国正在试验在蒸汽火车上安装车载数字信号系统，以确保其在未来铁路信号变革中的运行能力。这是全球首次在蒸汽机车上应用欧洲列车控制系统（ETCS），特别是对“A1”号60163“Tornado”蒸汽机车进行了改造，耗资约900万英镑。该项目由Network Rail主导，旨在保留蒸汽火车在全国铁路网的运营权。试验面临诸多技术挑战，包括如何在恶劣环境下（如震动、煤尘和高热）确保系统正常工作。Tornado成功完成了在Shrewsbury至Newtown和Welshpool线路上的测试，证明传统蒸汽机车可以与现代数字信号系统兼容。这一试验对蒸汽火车的未来至关重要，因为未来几年英国将全面推广ETCS系统。
data.comments_summary:

The cab of the 60163 Tornado with (top left) an electronic screen.

The cab of the 60163 Tornado with (top left) an electronic screen.
Photograph: Hitachi Rail
Rail transport
‘Nobody has done this before’: Britain’s beloved steam trains trial pioneering technology
In-cab digital signalling was tested last week as part of a project to secure the future of main-line locomotives
Daniel Puddicombe
Sat 19 Apr 2025 10.00 EDT
Last modified on Sat 19 Apr 2025 11.23 EDT
Share
About 500 steam trains run across the UK each year, from Penzance in the south to Inverness in the north,
­transporting tens of thousands of passengers to a bygone age
, ­bringing joy to the faces of enthusiasts and bemusing commuters.
But the future of main line steam operations could be under threat unless the traditional fire-breathing machines can be fitted with pioneering modern technology.
The UK’s railways are undergoing a major change to their signalling ­systems in the coming years.
Network Rail
is planning to remove traditional lineside colour light signals in favour of in-cab signalling systems along key routes. No steam locomotive in the world had ever been run with in-cab digital signalling – until now.
On a Monday night earlier this month, the new technology was ­trialled for the first time as part of a “pathfinder” project aimed at ­securing the future of steam locomotives in the UK.
The “A1” No.60163 Tornado –
Britain’s first steam locomotive to be built in 50 years
and which has appeared in the
Paddington 2
movie and on
Top Gear
– has been ­fitted with European Train Control System (ETCS) technology as part of a Network Rail-led initiative which was launched in 2021. Fitting the new technology cost about £9m.
View image in fullscreen
The Tornado crosses the Ribblehead viaduct in the Yorkshire Dales.
Photograph: Danny Lawson/PA
ETCS is to be rolled out across the country in the coming years and some trains will run in digital-only mode from the end of this year.
It is already widely used in Europe and is seen as the industry standard ­signalling system for high-speed lines. Since 2011, the Cambrian Coast Line has been operated exclusively using the system as part of a different pilot programme.
The Tornado ran west of Shrewsbury to Newtown and Welshpool overnight to trial the technology for the first time.
“It is existential to the sector if steam cannot run with ETCS … the team have done a brilliant job of ­getting us to this point,” a Network Rail spokesperson involved in the project told the
Observer
. “The pathfinder [project] is all about saying ‘this is going to be really hard, is it ­technically viable?’ Nobody has ever done it with a heritage vehicle.”
Since the privatisation of the railways, steam trains have been free to roam the national network subject to there being “white space” in the ­timetables around service trains.
“We had quite a few challenges fitting the systems,” Rob Morland, electrical engineer at The A1 Steam Locomotive Trust, Tornado’s ­owning group, told the
Observer
. “This is a very harsh environment: we’ve got heat, coal, coal dust, shocks and vibrations and they all stress the systems.”
A second steam-powered turbo generator, an axle-driven alternator and a dedicated battery bank had to be installed in order to power the equipment: “The cab was stripped back to bare metal because of the sheer number of new conduits, boxes and equipment and that was the only practical way to do it,” Morland added.
Amy Clouston, principal human factors specialist at engineering consultancy AtkinsRéalis, which designed the fitment of the systems, said: “We had to test whether or not you can even use a touchscreen while you’re hurtling along at up to 75mph. We’ve had to think about vibrations, lighting, noise, coal dust, water and steam and grubby fingers.”
Clouston said her team also had to factor in the placement of the screens to avoid being hit by a fireman ­swinging a shovel around, while still being in a position where the driver can still see the safety-critical ­information displayed.
“Drivers have varied positions: some drivers hang out of the cab, ­others stand. It isn’t a ‘I’m sat at a desk’ design of a modern diesel or electric locomotive,” she said.
Keeping the computers powering the systems cool also proved to be a headache: “The design team had the challenge of sealing them [against] coal dust and heat. Electronics in a sealed environment that’s already hot does not bode well [for the longevity],” she added.
“Tornado’s retrofit with our ETCS is a world-first project that has tested our technology in one of the most complex and harsh ­operating environments, proving heritage and digital systems can coexist ­without compromise,” Tank Porteous, ­main line signalling programme director at Hitachi Rail UK, a partner in the project, said.
Tornado is so far the only steam locomotive to have been fitted with the system. Last year Network Rail issued a £40m tender
43742449.article_summary: 英国正在试验在蒸汽火车上安装车载数字信号系统，以确保其在未来铁路信号变革中的运行能力。这是全球首次在蒸汽机车上应用欧洲列车控制系统（ETCS），特别是对“A1”号60163“Tornado”蒸汽机车进行了改造，耗资约900万英镑。该项目由Network Rail主导，旨在保留蒸汽火车在全国铁路网的运营权。试验面临诸多技术挑战，包括如何在恶劣环境下（如震动、煤尘和高热）确保系统正常工作。Tornado成功完成了在Shrewsbury至Newtown和Welshpool线路上的测试，证明传统蒸汽机车可以与现代数字信号系统兼容。这一试验对蒸汽火车的未来至关重要，因为未来几年英国将全面推广ETCS系统。

《为什么芯片行业难以吸引下一代人才》一文指出，全球半导体人才短缺，预计到2030年需要新增100万 skilled workers。文章讨论了芯片行业难以吸引新人才的六个原因：

1. **教育偏重理论**：大学课程过于强调理论，而非实际应用，导致学习曲线陡峭，吓退潜在人才。
2. **硬件与软件薪酬迷思**：许多人认为软件工程薪酬高于硬件，尽管现实并非如此绝对。
3. **研究生学位要求**：许多雇主要求芯片设计岗位具备研究生学历，限制了人才供应。
4. **过早专业化**：高度专门化的技能不易迁移，限制职业发展。
5. **文档短缺**：硬件设计多依赖内部知识，难以自学。
6. **芯片设计文化**：硬件公司氛围传统，工期紧张，错误代价高昂。

文章建议应采用更加**实用导向**的教育方法，根据实际应用设计课程，以吸引更多人才进入芯片行业。

补充讨论：
• osnium123总结了六个关键原因，其中包括要求研究生教育的坚持，暗示这一要求可能是行业人才短缺或高门槛的原因之一。
• 争议焦点在于芯片设计行业的高门槛（包括资金、教育和技能要求）是否合理，以及这种高门槛是否会限制行业的人才流入和创新机会。

总结：芯片设计行业因其小众、高门槛和地区薪资差异而面临人才吸引和培养的挑战，讨论中有人建议通过降低教育成本和增加激励来解决这些问题。同时，也有观点认为随着软件行业门槛的降低，硬件领域或将迎来新的发展机遇。

This is a
free
edition
of my weekly newsletter. Each week, I help readers learn about chip design, stay up-to-date on complex topics, and navigate a career in semiconductors. You can do this
short 3-question survey
to give your take on the issues in semiconductor hiring (responses are strictly kept confidential).
Vik's Newsletter is a publication for people interested in semiconductors. Please consider subscribing to the free or paid tier below.
Subscribe
There is a worldwide shortage of semiconductor talent.
Deloitte
estimates
that 1 million additional skilled workers are required to meet the semiconductor industry demand by 2030. Regardless of the accuracy of that number or timeline, we need a larger supply of well trained semiconductor professionals because chips are here to stay.
We have seen countries launch CHIPS programs to develop a homegrown supply of semiconductors that protects them from geopolitical turbulences and pandemic-inspired supply chain shortages. Unfortunately, the upskilling needed for semiconductor talent cannot happen overnight. There has been a systemic shift away from hardware engineering over the past few decades, and making semiconductors sexy again is no easy task.
In this article, we will discuss 6 reasons why the chip industry is struggling to attract new talent.
Theory-first education
: In an effort to build from fundamentals, there is too much emphasis on theory rather than a focus on applications.
Compensation myth
: There is a feeling that software pays more than hardware. Reality is not so cut and dry.
Graduate degrees
: A lot more employers ask for graduate level degrees to enter chip design creating bottlenecks in talent supply.
Early specialization
: Highly niche skillsets are less marketable and career limiting.
Documentation shortages
: Hardware design is entirely tribal knowledge and hard to self-learn.
Chip design culture
: Hardware companies have a
retro
feel to them, deadlines are tight, and mistakes are deadly.
Read time
: 8 mins
#1:
Semiconductor Education is Theory-First
Semiconductors sit at the intersection of math, physics, chemistry, mechanics, programming, and measurement — few fields are more interdisciplinary. The learning curve is steep, and students often face high barriers in time, effort, and financial cost.
To what extent do you need to go deep into the details? When you learn a programming language, you don’t think about the translation to bytecode, or how the instruction pipeline is executed in the CPU. There are experts who still work at low level machine interfaces but programming is mostly abstracted away by modern tools.
The same holds true in semiconductors to a large extent. An in-depth knowledge of transistor operation would benefit those who work on analog electronics, device modeling, or advanced manufacturing; but this would be of little use to digital designers, system level or test engineers because they operate at higher abstraction layers.
Yet most university programs still take a theory-first route. They start with an equation-centric approach with the good intention of laying a strong conceptual foundation. While I agree with having a good understanding of the basics, it need not be taught in an academic, theoretical sense. A more qualitative understanding is often sufficient. The difficulty of assimilating complex equations often drives away prospective engineers when they could have been a perfectly good fit for the industry.
What is needed is a
practical-first
approach to semiconductor design where the craft of designing silicon is highly tailored to the end application. One could always go deeper into the fundamentals on an as-needed basis. For example, learners could begin by building and simulating simple circuits before diving into solid-state theory. The current disconnect between how the field is practiced and how it’s taught is part of what’s keeping people out.

data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了现代网络应用带来的便利与问题，如数据盗窃风险和网络霸凌等，并介绍了作者作为家长对孩子互联网使用和教育的关注。作者回顾了自己童年时使用DOS和Windows 3.1系统的经历，并通过恢复旧软件和游戏，为孩子提供无网络依赖的教育内容。作者特别提到了一款1985年发布的DOS游戏《1st Math》，它帮助孩子学习数学和基本键盘操作，同时培养精细运动技能。作者的长期目标是设立一台“旧电脑”，让孩子在没有网络风险的环境下学习和使用电脑技能，同时配合适龄的现代内容和指导，以培养孩子的计算机能力和良好品德。文章还预告了后续将介绍设置虚拟机和恢复旧磁盘的技术细节。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何为儿童提供安全、有益的数字学习环境，同时避免当代互联网的负面影响（如过度消费、网络霸凌、不良内容等）。

不同观点：
• **支持使用复古软件和有限媒体**：一些评论者（如pkdpic、yazantapuz、ThomasBb）支持使用旧的计算机和教育软件，如Math Blaster、DOS游戏等，认为这些软件不仅能激发孩子的学习兴趣，还能在一定程度上自然地限制屏幕时间和内容消费。他们认为复古软件的"无聊"特性有助于孩子自我调节使用时间，并避免现代互联网的负面影响。

• **支持定制硬件和有限网络访问**：K0balt建议设计一款专为儿童定制的便携式电脑，使用DOS模拟器或RISC-V架构，预装教育软件和游戏，但不提供标准网络访问。这种设备可以通过有限的方式（如PPPOE连接）实现网络功能，同时加强 parental control（家长控制）以避免不良行为者。

• **强调实体教具和动手学习的重要性**：doodlebugging指出，虽然数字软件有其价值，但实体教具（如拼图、积木等）在帮助孩子理解物理概念、机械装置和平衡等方面有不可替代的作用。这些教具能提供计算机显示器无法轻易传达的物理体验。

• **数字内容的筛选与控制难题**：philips强调了在当前数字环境下，家长和教师在为孩子筛选高质量、适龄内容方面的挑战。现代平台（如Netflix、Kindle Kids）的家长控制功能往往有限或难以操作，而完全屏蔽信息也并非理想选择。

• **反对过度限制互联网访问**：TexanFeller通过个人经历反对过度控制孩子访问互联网内容，认为限制信息获取可能会导致孩子在面对现实世界问题时缺乏准备。他主张与孩子讨论挑战性话题，而不是简单地屏蔽它们。

补充讨论：
• **复古计算的实践与技术细节**：一些评论者（如rietta、j45）分享了如何通过模拟器（如QEMU）或旧硬件（如iMac G3、Raspberry Pi）来实现复古计算环境，并提供了具体的软件和设置建议。

• **现代替代方案**：elsonrodriguez和一些其他评论者提到，现代教育软件（如GCompris、Endless系列）也能提供高质量的学习体验，且更易于在当前设备上运行。

• **个人经历与反思**：bitwize和TexanFeller分享了个人成长经历，讨论了限制与开放互联网访问对孩子成长的不同影响，提供了对数字育儿更广泛的理解和反思。

争议焦点：
• **互联网访问的控制与自由**：如何在保护儿童免受互联网不良内容影响的同时，确保他们能够获取广泛的信息和学习资源，是讨论的核心争议点。

43747283.article_content:
We live in a day where web applications and apps have become the mainstream. These bring many conveniences, such as inter-connectivity with multiple devices, and backups of personal data. It also brings many issues like risk of data theft, loss of software access when the publisher ceases operations, and the risks of cyber-bullying for school-aged children. There are more issues to consider, but these will suffice to set the scene.
At work, my team and I work hard to keep important web applications up to date and secured. But at home, my wife and I, as parents of small children have become increasingly concerned about their education and how much internet access we want them to have. We do not hide the internet from them, but do allow access to age appropriate content. We have a “kid’s iPad” set up that we will use for movies on long road trips and such. However, I have increasingly wanted to make sure they have access to older educational content that is not dependent on the will of a publisher and does not constantly connect them with possible cyber-bullying.
To this end, I have picked up a hobby restoring Windows 3.1 and various games. I have always had access to computers. My dad had a home office PC in 1985 and I learned about DOS and spreadsheets and more. We then had a Windows 3.1 computer in the early nineties that had a CDROM and both kinds of floppy disks. At some point during the late nineties I decided to copy a bunch of our 5.25 inch floppies to 3.5 inch floppy and then from that to a hard disk. I have since copied this “Diskette Collection” forward until modern day. We have even more old titles at my parents' house which have been stored in an air conditioned condition. I am aware that there is a collection of abandonware software on archive.org that can be considered.
I have been restoring software that I still have possession of the original media or that is clearly marked as sharewhare in a QEMU virtual machine on a Ubuntu Linux host computer. It ends up looking like this window below and can also be loaded in full screen mode:
To digress a bit from the topic of old software for the kids, I would like to point out that older software had a lot of UI advantages compared to the modern day. For example, WordPerfect 6 has a very good user interface to learn on. Everything is clearly labeled with big buttons and no mystery gestures. It shows how discoverable functions of older software was. I remember Wordperfect was amazing to use to write essays in school without distraction. I could learn all of the functionality from the menus directly or Help without having to fall back to searching YouTube (which didn’t exist then). We have lost a lot of discoverability in modern systems, to our collective shame.
Back to the learning aspects, one of the games our 4 year old loves to play is 1st Math, which was published by Elmer Larsen in 1985! It is amazing to watch this young child play a learning game that aws published 39 years ago! She loves it!
1st Math is a DOS game and it has multiple subjects the children can learn:
Equation
Addition
Subtraction
Construction
Addition
Subtraction
Freight Depot
Various sorting games that have a claw pickup feel to it
Pattern matching
Our daughter is doing very well with the addition game, which is extremely neat because she can count the objects on the screen. Then has to find the associated button on the keyboard for that number. I feel this has a strong educational element that is lost in the days of iPads where children just tap and swipe. Instead, she has to see and recoginize the number and remember it as she looks for the key on the keyboard. Using the keyboard also develops fine motor skills, which are important for future writing and typing skills.
The other extremely fun game are the Freight Depot games. She has to move the animated crane truck with the arrow keys and then press down to pick up a block, then move it, then drop it off in the correct order. This is helping her develop basic keyboard skills really quickly! The game sounds are delightfully synthetic from the 1980s!
My long term goal will be to have an “old computer” set up in the house for the kids to play on, learn to type, and more without the risk of undue exposure to the internet, advertising, and bullying. We will work to expose them to the modern content as age appropriate and with proper guidance. We want to raise strong kids who have great computer skills and know how to treat everyone with dignity and respect.
I will write more later about the technical aspects of setting up a virtual machine, restoring old diskettes to disk images, and creating new virtual diskette images with Linux to copy old software into the virtual machine via a virtual Drive A. I have plans to not only do this as a VM, but also to build a physical computer that has the ability to read all the old floppy drives. data.title: Where did the false "equal transit-time" explanation of lift originate from?
data.author: IdealeZahlen
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了关于升力产生的错误“等穿越时间”理论的起源。该理论声称，机翼产生升力是因为翼形不对称，迫使上方空气流速更快，从而与下方空气同时到达后缘，依据伯努利方程，下翼面的压力必须更高。文章提到，这一错误理论曾被广泛传播，尤其在学校教育中，但如今更多是被用来进行 debunk。根据Klaus Weltner和Martin Ingelman-Sundberg的研究，该误解可能源自1922年空气动力学先驱Ludwig Prandtl的一幅图示，该图示试图展示空气在内层附着于表面的现象，但被错误解读为相邻空气必须在机翼末端重新汇合。文章还指出，这种简化的解释因其直观和易于理解而流行，但实际上是错误的。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于升力原理的解释及其在教育和实际应用中的争议

不同观点：
• **financetechbro** 指出，目前我们并不完全理解升力是如何产生的，表明升力问题具有复杂性。
• **smallbugfound** 强烈反对使用等时到达理论（equal transit time theorem）来解释升力，认为这是一种误导，容易让学生产生困惑，并强调该理论基本上是错误的。
• **dguest** 认为使用牛顿第三定律来解释升力比等时到达理论更合适，虽然不完整，但至少不是错误的，并提到曾在 grade school 学习时就感到困惑。
• **dr_dshiv** 将升力误解与其他科学误解（如季节变化或历史误解）进行类比，暗示科学教育中普遍存在简化解释的问题。
• **bobbyraduloff** 指出 NASA 网站上存在两种互相矛盾的升力解释，质疑权威信息来源的可靠性。
• **magicalhippo** 分享了 YouTube 上 William Fraser 的视频，讨论了等时到达理论的问题，并提到 Fraser 正在开发一种基于粒子的模拟器以更好地解释升力发展过程。
• **marcus_holmes** 描述了在帆船课程中遇到的类似问题，教师使用已被证伪的理论解释“拉模式”，但他选择不争论，以免 disrupt 课堂。

补充讨论：
• **samuelfekete** 证实 NASA.gov 上仍然使用等时到达理论来解释升力。
• **bandrami** 以幽默的方式提出将飞机放在跑步机上的假设，暗示对升力问题复杂性的调侃。
• **bowsamic** 提到在 A level 物理课程中遇到升力解释问题，导致班级内的不满，并对物理教育产生怀疑。
• **nonrandomstring** 引用科学家对流体力学复杂性的调侃，提到即使是著名科学家也对湍流问题感到困惑。
• **artemonster** 请求一个简明的正确解释（TLDR）。
• **lordnacho** 试图总结一些与升力相关的正确概念，如翼尖涡流和飞机倒飞现象，并希望获得更准确的解释，而不是依赖 AI 的表面解释。

争议焦点：
• 等时到达理论是否为误导性解释，以及其在教育中的使用是否合适。
• 不同升力解释的准确性及其在实际应用（如飞行和帆船）中的有效性。
• 权威来源（如 NASA）提供的信息存在矛盾，导致公众对科学解释的信任问题。

总结：讨论围绕升力原理的多种解释及其在教育和实际应用中的有效性展开，参与者对等时到达理论的误导性表示强烈不满，并对科学教育中简化解释的做法提出质疑。

$\begingroup$
It's supposedly a "widely circulated" false claim that wings generate lift because of their asymmetric shape, forcing air above to travel faster so that they meet up on the trailing edge at the same time as air below, and by Bernoulli's equation, the pressure below the wing must therefore be higher.
Source:
https://www.grc.nasa.gov/WWW/k-12/airplane/wrong1.html
I've only ever encountered this "equal transit-time" theory when it's being debunked, so it seems like its more common to see it pointed out as wrong rather than alleged to be true.
Was this incorrect theory ever a common misconception? And did this misconception originate from a particular source?
